record.issue_text: app/assets/javascripts/embed.js:12 — comments` is null when `#discourse-comments` is absent, throwing TypeError; `discourseUrl` must end with a slash or the iframe src is malformed

adjudication.rationale: In new `app/assets/javascripts/embed.js`, `comments` is set via `document.getElementById('discourse-comments')` and then unconditionally used as `comments.appendChild(iframe);`. If the host page does not include an element with id `discourse-comments`, `comments` will be `null` and this will throw a `TypeError`, breaking the embed script. Also, `iframe.src` is built with `discourseUrl + "embed/best?..."`; if `discourseUrl` lacks a trailing slash, the resulting URL will be malformed (e.g., `https://site.comembed/best...`). The diff provides no normalization/guard for either case.
